usage: siso-gen --xml <SISO-REF-010.xml> --out <dir>

  --xml <path>   Path to the SISO-REF-010 XML document.
                 Official: https://www.sisostandards.org/page/ReferenceDocuments (login).
                 Mirror:   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/open-dis/opendis7-source-generator/master/xml/SISO/SISO-REF-010.xml
  --out <dir>    Target directory for generated C# enums. Optional when
                 invoked from inside a Bowire.Protocol.Dis checkout —
                 then it defaults to src/Kuestenlogik.Bowire.Protocol.Dis/Enumerations/Generated.

Install as a .NET tool:
  dotnet tool install -g Kuestenlogik.Bowire.Protocol.Dis.SisoGen

Example:
  siso-gen --xml SISO-REF-010.xml --out ./src/MyProject/Enums/Generated
